name: animated-accordion
title: Animated Accordion
description: Expandable sections that reveal their answers with a staggered fade.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette. Any theme but Default also tints the questions, icon and hover line.

props.name: mode
props.label: Mode
props.description: Light or dark version of the chosen palette.

props.name: multiple
props.label: Multiple open
props.description: Lets more than one item stay open at a time. Off while Open on hover is on.

props.name: openOnHover
props.label: Open on hover
props.description: Opens an item when the pointer rests on it, and closes it on leave.

props.name: bordered
props.label: Border
props.description: Draws a rounded border around the whole accordion.

props.name: borderRounded
props.label: Border roundness
props.description: Corner radius of the outer border. Needs Border on.

props.name: elastic
props.label: Elastic
props.description: Uses springs for opening, so panels and the fill overshoot slightly.

props.name: duration
props.label: Duration
props.description: How long opening and closing take, in seconds.

props.name: bounce
props.label: Bounce
props.description: How much the springs overshoot. Needs Elastic on.

props.name: delay
props.label: Delay
props.description: Wait before the answer's paragraphs start fading in, in seconds.

props.name: stagger
props.label: Stagger
props.description: Gap between each paragraph's fade-in, in seconds.

props.name: fill
props.label: Fill
props.description: Fills an open item's background with a colour.

props.name: fillColor
props.label: Fill colour
props.description: Background colour of an open item. Needs Fill on.

props.name: rounded
props.label: Fill roundness
props.description: Corner radius of an open item's fill. Needs Fill on.

props.name: showLine
props.label: Hover line
props.description: Draws a line under an item on hover and while it's open.

props.name: icon
props.label: Icon
props.description: Plus that turns into a minus, or a chevron that flips.
